title: Sheet-metal jog operation
summary: Z-shaped offsets are now a first-class sheet-metal feature, plumbed all the way from IR through kernel, engine, and MCP.
details:
## What's New

- **`SheetMetalJog` IR op** (Rust + TS): offset, length, radius, direction.
- **`add_jog` kernel function** in `vcad-kernel-sheet::jog`: two equal-and-opposite 90° bends. Tail panel ends up parallel to the parent and `offset` mm above. Bends are tagged `;jog:a` / `;jog:b` so the UI labels them as jog members rather than generic flanges.
- **`sheet_metal_create` MCP tool** gained a `jogs` array alongside `flanges` and `hems` — the three core sheet-metal moves now compose in one call.
- Reuses every downstream system: lossless unfold, layered DXF, DFM check, cost, springback, suggest_fix — jogs flow through unchanged.
